findings.replacementEvidence: Exact current maker SKU/In stock main offer, pinned CC-BY-SA4.0 EAGLE v10,13 reviewed physical contacts and thermal-routing slots.

paddingReview.method: Reviewed exact maker/SKU, public product/guide/CAD identities, board SHA matches, module classification, unpopulated-carrier labels and normalized color/header descriptions. Different vendors using one IC are distinct carrier designs; memory/protocol/controller generations are not merged simply by name.

summary.status: Final1000 registration reviewed; no unresolved confirmed SKU/source/population/color duplicates.

preservation.fingerprintScope: Full component definition, labeled/unlabeled SVG, KiCad symbol/footprint/generated WRL. All 1,002 before/after hashes asserted equal by the integration review.

accuracy.generatedModels: All 1,000 new generated WRL models are approximate(3D:A).
accuracy.scope: C means source-coordinate contact reference; R means approximate/reference or off-board termination carrier. Neither native parsing nor an external manufacturer CAD URL establishes production/mating accuracy. Reverse-side source contacts may be flattened into the reference F.Cu pattern; do not interpret it as a production board-mating footprint.

validation.catalogValidation: Passed; generated COMPONENTS.md refreshed and freshness checked.

nativeKiCad.scope: Exact generated symbol definitions combined under their common unchanged library header; each complete generated footprint opened by the native KiCad exporter. This verifies native parsing, not production or mating accuracy.

versionedBuild.scope: Local packaged static site served over HTTP in browser; all module/CSS asset paths verified. No public deployment performed.

reviewNotes: Source SKU, revision, physical contacts and positive manufacturer offers retained in the five family audits. Inventory is a dated source snapshot.
Source CAD links pointing to other boards, contradictory revision/pin tables, and unresolved auxiliary ports were excluded or replaced.

Color-only OLED variants and the connector-population-only SparkFun PRT-08780 RS232 variant were not counted as distinct additions. Functionally different fitted sensor elements are distinct modules even when their carrier CAD matches.

Important electrical corrections include SC18IS602B SPI-master directions, LCD Mono DISP/COM inputs, LDC3114 data outputs, THVD1424 half-duplex Y/Z use, voltage-prefixed enable controls, and separately isolated ground domains.

All source-photo, labeled and unlabeled illustration reviews are recorded in the owner audits. Illustrations use original simplified primitives; component finish/height and generated 3D remain representative.
